owner_calls.question: The place's only entry (Eyes of Wakanda#1) is set on Minoan Crete, but the pin sits at Athens [37.9, 23.7], about 300 km away, under the name "Ancient Greece". Keep the broad Greece pin, or move/rename it to Crete?
options: Keep "Ancient Greece" at [37.9, 23.7] (Crete is inside the region)
Move the pin to Crete [35.2, 24.9] and keep the name
Rename the place "Crete" (region "Aegean Sea") and move it to [35.2, 24.9]
owner_calls.evidence: Wikipedia's episode summary: Noni allows herself to be captured during a raid on Minoan Crete in 1260 BC. The entry itself is correct; only the pin and name are a judgment call.
